answer_1.quote: Large Language Models (LLMs) are being used as sources of factual knowledge for search engines and other downstream tasks.
answer_1.outputs: The generated prompts are able to guide the LLMs in producing accurate responses associated with the injected knowledge.

answer_2.quote: Following , we evaluate multilingual knowledge editing with the following four metrics: (1) Reliability evaluates the average accuracy of an LLM on all edited instances... (2) Generality measures the average accuracy... (3) Locality assesses the average accuracy... (4) Portability estimates the average accuracy...
